name: Shrimp Al Burro with Broccoli
instructions: Boil 8 oz of pasta in well-salted water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of starchy pasta water before draining.

Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté 2 cups of broccoli florets with a pinch of salt for 4 to 5 minutes until tender-crisp and lightly browned, then transfer to a plate.

In the same skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter, add 3 cloves of minced garlic and 1 lb of peeled shrimp seasoned with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and cook 2 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Lower the heat to low, add the drained pasta, sautéed broccoli, 2 tablespoons of cold butter, and 1/2 cup of the reserved pasta water; toss vigorously as the cold butter melts into a creamy base.

Gradually sprinkle in 1/2 cup of finely grated parmesan and the juice of 1/2 lemon while tossing constantly, adding splashes of pasta water as needed until a glossy, emulsified al burro sauce coats the pasta and shrimp.

name: Molly's Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Pat 1 lb of peeled, deveined shrimp dry with paper towels so they sear properly instead of steaming.
Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until foaming, then add 4 cloves of thinly sliced or minced garlic and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant without browning.
Arrange the shrimp in a single flat layer in the skillet and sear for 1.5 to 2 minutes per side until pink and just curled.
Remove the skillet from the heat immediately, squeeze in the juice of 1 fresh lemon, and toss with 2 tablespoons of finely chopped fresh parsley to create a bright, buttery pan sauce.

name: Spaghetti Puttanesca
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook 12 oz of spaghetti until just shy of al dente, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.

Meanwhile, heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat; add 4 anchovy fillets, 3 cloves of minced garlic, and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, mashing the anchovies with a wooden spoon until they dissolve into the oil.
Stir in 1 can (14.5 oz) crushed or diced tomatoes, 2 tablespoons drained capers, 1/2 cup pitted and halved black olives, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper; simmer briskly for 10 minutes until thickened.

Transfer the spaghetti directly into the skillet with 1/4 cup of the reserved pasta water and toss over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until the pasta absorbs the sauce, then finish with 1/2 cup grated parmesan.

name: Fish Piccata
instructions: Pat 4 thin white fish fillets (about 1.5 lbs total, such as cod or flounder) completely dry, season with 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, and dredge lightly in 1/3 cup all-purpose flour, shaking off any excess.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering, then sear the fillets for 2.5 to 3 minutes per side until a golden crust forms; transfer to a warm platter.
Lower the heat to medium, pour in 1/2 cup dry white wine and the juice of 1 lemon, and simmer for 2 minutes while scraping up the browned flour bits from the pan.

Turn the heat to low, add 2 tablespoons drained capers and 3 tablespoons cold unsalted butter cut into cubes, swirling the pan until the butter emulsifies into a velvety sauce; spoon over the fish and garnish with 2 tablespoons chopped parsley.

name: Har Gow
instructions: Roughly chop 1/2 lb of peeled, deveined shrimp (smashing half into a paste with the flat of your knife for bounce) and mix with 1/4 cup finely minced bamboo shoots, 1 teaspoon oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, 1/4 teaspoon white pepper, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1 teaspoon sugar; cover and chill for 30 minutes.

In a heatproof bowl, whisk 1 cup wheat starch and 1/4 cup cornstarch, then pour in 3/4 cup rolling boiling water while stirring rapidly with chopsticks until clumpy; cover for 3 minutes, then knead in 1 tablespoon vegetable oil until smooth and pliable.
Keep the dough covered with a damp towel, pinch off 16 equal pieces, and press each under the flat blade of an oiled cleaver or rolling pin into a thin 3-inch circle.

Place 1 tablespoon of chilled shrimp filling in the center of each wrapper, pleat one edge 6 to 7 times while pressing against the flat back edge to seal into a crescent, and steam over boiling water on perforated parchment for 6 to 8 minutes until translucent.

name: Crab Rangoons
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine 8 oz softened cream cheese, 6 oz finely minced imitation crab, 2 thinly sliced scallions, 1/2 teaspoon onion powder, and 1/4 teaspoon salt until smooth and uniform.
Lay out 24 square wonton wrappers, place 1 heaped teaspoon of filling in the center of each, and brush all four edges lightly with water.
Bring the four corners up to meet in the center and pinch all seams firmly shut so no air pockets remain (which prevents bursting during frying).
Heat 2 inches of neutral frying oil in a heavy pot to 350°F and fry the rangoons in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden brown and blistered, then drain on a wire rack or paper towels.

name: Caesar Salad Wrap
instructions: Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat and sear 1 cup of vegetarian chicken strips with 1/2 teaspoon Italian blend seasoning for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp on the edges.
In a bowl, toss 2 cups of chopped crisp romaine lettuce with 2 tablespoons Caesar dressing, 2 tablespoons grated parmesan, and 1/4 teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper until evenly coated.

Warm 1 large 10-inch flour tortilla in a dry pan or microwave for 10 seconds to make it pliable, pile the dressed Caesar salad and warm vegetarian chicken down the center, fold in the left and right sides, and roll tightly from the bottom up.

name: Mac-And-Cheese
instructions: Boil 1 lb of elbow or cavatappi pasta in salted water for 1 minute less than package directions until al dente, then drain.
In a large Dutch oven over medium heat, melt 4 tablespoons of butter, whisk in 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until pale golden and bubbly.
Slowly pour in 1/4 cup dry white wine while whisking smoothly, followed by 1.5 cups heavy cream and 1/2 cup water; simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Whisk in 1 teaspoon yellow mustard, 1 teaspoon hot sauce, 1/2 teaspoon each of onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, and salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.

Turn off the heat completely and stir in 1.5 cups freshly shredded extra sharp cheddar, 1 cup shredded mozzarella, and 1 cup shredded smoked gouda one handful at a time until smooth, then fold in the cooked pasta.

name: Salmon Cous Cous Bowl
instructions: Crush a generous pinch of saffron threads into 1.5 cups boiling water with 1/4 teaspoon salt, stir in 1 cup dry couscous, cover tightly off the heat for 10 minutes, and fluff with a fork.

Rub 2 salmon fillets (12 oz total) with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon onion powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper; roast on a lined baking sheet at 400°F for 12 to 15 minutes until flaky.

Grate 1/3 cup cucumber, squeeze out excess liquid in a paper towel, and mix with 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill, 1 clove minced garlic, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.

Assemble bowls with a base of saffron couscous, the roasted salmon, 2 tablespoons hummus, cucumber-dill yogurt sauce, 1/2 cup diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper, 1/2 cup thinly shredded purple cabbage, 1/4 cup sliced black olives, and 1/3 cup crumbled feta cheese.

name: Shrimp Udon Soup
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a boil, gently lower in 2 eggs, boil for 6.5 minutes for jammy yolks, then transfer to an ice bath and peel.
In a soup pot over medium heat, warm 1 tablespoon sesame oil and sauté 1/2 thinly sliced onion, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon grated ginger for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant.

Pour in 4 cups water and whisk in 1 tablespoon vegetable broth paste, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes; bring to a simmer.
Add 2 packs (14 oz) frozen or fresh udon noodles, 2 cups chopped bok choy or cabbage, and 1/2 lb peeled shrimp; simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the noodles loosen and the shrimp turn pink.
Divide into bowls and garnish each with a halved jammy egg, 2 sliced green onions, and 1 teaspoon chili crisp oil.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala
instructions: Whisk 1/2 cup Greek yogurt with 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon grated ginger, 1 teaspoon Kashmiri red chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; toss 14 oz cubed paneer and 1 chopped red bell pepper in the marinade and chill 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the marinated paneer and bell peppers for 2 minutes per side until lightly charred, then set aside.

In a pot, combine 1 chopped onion, 3 roughly chopped tomatoes, 1/4 cup raw cashews, 3 green cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, 1 bay leaf, and 1.5 cups water; simmer covered for 15 minutes until soft, remove the whole spices, and blend until silky smooth.

Pour the blended masala gravy back into the pan over medium heat, stir in 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1 teaspoon crushed dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), 1 teaspoon sugar, and 1/3 cup heavy cream, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Fold in the seared paneer and peppers, simmer 2 minutes more to warm through, and finish with 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro.

name: Punjabi Potato Samosas
instructions: Rub 1/4 cup melted ghee into 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds until crumbly; knead in 1/2 cup water gradually to form a firm, stiff dough, cover with a damp cloth, and rest 30 minutes.
Boil 3 medium potatoes until fork-tender, peel, and coarsely mash with a fork so small chunks remain.

Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil over medium heat, sizzle 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1 tablespoon minced ginger, 2 finely chopped green chilies, and a pinch of asafoetida for 30 seconds, then stir in the potatoes, 1/2 cup green peas, 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1 teaspoon cumin powder, 1 teaspoon fennel powder, 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro; let cool completely.

Divide dough into 6 balls, roll each into a thin 7-inch oval, cut in half horizontally, brush the straight edge with water, fold into a cone, stuff with 2 tablespoons cooled filling, and pinch the top edge shut.
Deep-fry in vegetable oil heated to 325°F (medium-low) for 7 to 9 minutes, turning occasionally, until blister-free, golden brown, and flaky.

name: Ojingeo Deopbap
instructions: Rinse 1.5 cups short-grain rice until water runs clear, then cook in 2 cups water with a pinch of salt until steamed and tender.
Clean 1 lb of squid, score the inside in a shallow diamond crosshatch pattern, and slice into 1.5-inch bite-sized pieces.

In a small bowl, whisk 2 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon gochugaru (Korean chili flakes), 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon rice wine, 1 tablespoon sugar, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1 teaspoon Korean chili oil, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.

Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a wok or wide skillet over high heat, stir-fry 1/2 sliced onion, 1/2 julienned carrot, and 1.5 cups chopped green cabbage for 2 minutes, then add the squid and sauce and stir-fry rapidly for 2 minutes until the squid curls and turns opaque (do not overcook).
Remove from heat, toss with 1 teaspoon sesame oil, and serve over warm rice topped with 2 sliced green onions, 1 teaspoon toasted sesame seeds, and 1 crispy fried egg.

name: Yubu Kimbap
instructions: Fold 1 tablespoon sesame oil and 1/2 teaspoon sea salt into 2 cups warm cooked short-grain rice and let cool slightly.
Simmer 6 deep-fried tofu pouches (yubu) in 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon vinegar, and 1/4 cup water for 5 minutes until seasoned, then squeeze gently and slice into strips.
Sauté 1 julienned carrot in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes until tender-crisp; whisk 3 eggs with 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, cook into a thin flat omelet, and slice into long strips.

Place 1 sheet of roasted seaweed (gim) shiny-side down on a bamboo mat, spread 1/2 cup seasoned rice evenly over two-thirds of the sheet, and layer 2 perilla leaves, marinated tofu strips, egg strips, carrots, and 1 strip of yellow radish pickle across the center.
Roll tightly away from you using the mat, seal the top edge with a few grains of rice, brush the outside lightly with sesame oil, and slice into 1/2-inch bite-sized rounds.

name: Amber's Paksiw na Isda
instructions: Slice 1 2-inch knob of ginger into strips, crush 4 cloves of garlic, and slice 1 medium onion; arrange them in an even bed across the bottom of a wide pot or deep skillet to prevent sticking.
Lay 1.5 lbs of cleaned fish steaks or whole small fish (such as bangus, mackerel, or tilapia) and 1 sliced, seeded bitter gourd (ampalaya) over the aromatics.
Pour in 1/2 cup cane or white vinegar and 1/2 cup water, then scatter 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorns, 1 teaspoon salt, and 2 whole green finger chilies over the top.

Bring to a rolling boil uncovered without stirring (to cook off the raw vinegar bite), then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until the fish is tender and the broth reduces slightly.

name: Caprese Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast 2 thick-cut slices of crusty sourdough bread until deeply golden and sturdy enough to hold toppings.
Halve and pit 1 ripe avocado, scoop the flesh onto the warm toast, mash coarsely with a fork, and season evenly with 1/4 teaspoon flaky salt and 1/4 teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper.
Layer 4 slices of fresh mozzarella and 1/2 cup halved cherry tomatoes over the avocado, scatter 4 torn fresh basil leaves on top, and finish with a 1-tablespoon drizzle of balsamic glaze.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Bring 4 cups of vegetable broth to a gentle simmer in a saucepan and keep warm over low heat; in a separate wide pan, sear 8 oz sliced cremini mushrooms in 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until browned, then set aside.

Lower heat to medium, melt 1 tablespoon butter in the pan, sauté 2 finely minced shallots and 2 cloves minced garlic for 2 minutes until translucent, then add 1 cup dry arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until the edges turn translucent.
Pour in 1/2 cup dry white wine and stir continuously until completely absorbed.

Add the warm vegetable broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is nearly absorbed before adding the next (about 18 to 20 minutes total) until the rice is creamy yet al dente.
Remove from heat and vigorously fold in the seared mushrooms, 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese, and 1 remaining tablespoon of cold butter until glossy.

name: Grilled Fish Tacos
instructions: Pat 1 lb of tilapia fillets dry and rub all over with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon chili powder, and the juice of 1/2 lime.
Grill over medium-high heat or sear in a hot cast-iron skillet for 3 to 4 minutes per side until lightly charred and flaky, then transfer to a plate and break into large chunks.
Char 6 corn tortillas directly over a gas burner or in a dry skillet for 20 seconds per side until pliable.
Assemble tacos with the warm tortillas, flaked tilapia, 1.5 cups crisp cabbage slaw, 1 sliced ripe avocado, 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, and wedges from the remaining 1/2 lime.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Cod
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F, pat 4 cod fillets (about 1.5 lbs) dry with paper towels, and arrange them in a lightly greased baking dish.

In a small bowl, whisk 2 tablespoons olive oil, the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 3 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh dill, 1 tablespoon chopped parsley, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.
Spoon the lemon-herb mixture evenly over the cod fillets and bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the fish is opaque throughout and flakes effortlessly with a fork.

name: Chicken Fried Rice with Tamari
instructions: Cut 1 lb of boneless, skinless chicken breast into 1/2-inch dice and stir-fry in a hot, lightly oiled wok or skillet over high heat for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Push the chicken to one side of the pan, pour 2 lightly beaten eggs into the empty space, scramble until softly set, and mix with the chicken.
Add 1/2 cup finely diced carrots and 1/2 cup peas, stir-frying for 2 minutes until tender-crisp.

Break up 3 cups of cold, day-old cooked jasmine rice into the pan, drizzle in 3 tablespoons gluten-free tamari and 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil, and toss over high heat for 3 minutes until steaming; garnish with 3 sliced green onions.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F; slice the tops off 4 large bell peppers, scoop out the seeds and membranes, place cut-side up in a baking dish, and pre-bake for 15 minutes to soften.
Meanwhile, brown 1 lb of ground beef and 1 diced medium onion in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 to 7 minutes, breaking up the meat, then drain excess grease.
Stir 1.5 cups cooked white rice, 1 cup tomato sauce, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper into the beef mixture until well combined.
Divide the filling evenly among the pre-baked peppers, mound 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese over the tops, and bake uncovered for 20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Classic Beef Bolognese
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and sauté 1 finely diced medium onion for 5 minutes until softened, then add 3 cloves minced garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Increase heat to medium-high, add 1 lb of ground beef, and cook for 6 to 7 minutes, breaking it up finely with a wooden spoon until well browned.
Pour in 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, and 1 teaspoon salt; reduce heat to low and simmer gently uncovered for 25 minutes until rich and thick.
Boil 12 oz of spaghetti in salted water until al dente, drain, toss directly with the Bolognese sauce, and serve topped with 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese.

name: Greek Lemon Herb Chicken Thighs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and pat 2 lbs of bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels.

In a large bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons olive oil, 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice, 4 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, then toss the chicken thighs until thoroughly coated.

Arrange the thighs skin-side up on a foil-lined baking sheet and roast for 28 to 32 minutes until the skin is deeply golden and crisp and an instant-read thermometer reaches 175°F in the thickest part.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
instructions: Sauté 1 sliced onion, 2 diced carrots, and 2 diced Yukon gold potatoes in 1 tablespoon oil for 5 minutes, add 3.5 cups water, and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Turn heat to low, dissolve 4 blocks of Japanese curry roux into the broth, and simmer 5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Pound 2 chicken breasts to 1/2-inch thickness, season with salt and pepper, dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, and press firmly into panko breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry the cutlets in 1/2 inch of 350°F oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden brown, slice into strips, and serve over steamed rice alongside the curry.

name: Agedashi Tofu
instructions: Press 14 oz firm tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes, cut into 8 cubes, and coat lightly in potato starch.
Simmer 1 cup kombu dashi, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, and 2 tablespoons mirin in a small saucepan for 2 minutes to make tentsuyu broth.
Fry the tofu cubes in 1 inch of 350°F oil for 3 minutes until crisp and blistered outside, then drain on a wire rack.
Place tofu in shallow bowls, pour the warm broth around the base, and top with grated daikon, grated ginger, and sliced green onions.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Donburi
instructions: Whisk 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 3 tablespoons mirin, 2 tablespoons sake, and 1 tablespoon sugar in a small bowl until dissolved.
Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and sear 2 skin-on salmon fillets skin-side down for 4 minutes until crisp.
Flip the salmon, pour in the teriyaki sauce, and simmer for 3 minutes while spooning the bubbling glaze over the fillets until thick.
Serve over bowls of steamed short-grain rice with steamed broccoli florets and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Miso Glazed Eggplant (Nasu Dengaku)
instructions: Halve 3 Japanese eggplants lengthwise, score the flesh in a deep diamond crosshatch without piercing the skin, and brush with sesame oil.
Broil cut-side up 6 inches from the heat for 8 to 10 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Whisk 3 tablespoons white miso, 2 tablespoons mirin, 1 tablespoon sake, and 1 tablespoon sugar in a small saucepan over low heat for 2 minutes until glossy.
Spread the miso glaze over the broiled eggplants, broil 2 minutes more until bubbling and caramelized, and garnish with sesame seeds and scallions.

name: Vegetable Gyoza
instructions: Finely mince 2 cups napa cabbage, toss with 1/2 teaspoon salt for 10 minutes, and squeeze completely dry in a clean kitchen towel.

Mix the cabbage with 1 cup minced shiitake mushrooms, 1/2 cup crumbled pressed tofu, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 teaspoon grated ginger, 2 sliced green onions, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 1 teaspoon sesame oil.
Place 1 tablespoon filling in each gyoza wrapper, moisten the rim with water, and pleat the front edge closed into a crescent.
Pan-fry flat-side down in 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes until golden, pour in 1/3 cup water, cover immediately, and steam 4 minutes until water evaporates.

name: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Boil 12 oz spaghetti in lightly salted water until 2 minutes shy of al dente, reserving 1.5 cups of starchy cooking water.
Toast 2 teaspoons freshly cracked black pepper in a dry wide skillet over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant, then add 3/4 cup pasta water.
Transfer the pasta to the skillet and toss briskly for 1 minute until half the liquid reduces, then remove the pan completely from the heat.
Gradually sprinkle in 1.5 cups finely grated Pecorino Romano while tossing vigorously and adding splashes of warm pasta water until a smooth, creamy emulsion forms.

name: Eggplant Parmigiana
instructions: Slice 2 large eggplants into 1/3-inch rounds, salt lightly on both sides, and let drain on paper towels for 20 minutes before patting dry.
Dredge eggplant slices in flour, dip in beaten eggs, coat in seasoned breadcrumbs, and pan-fry in olive oil for 2 minutes per side until golden.
In a 9x13 baking dish, layer marinara sauce, fried eggplant slices, torn fresh mozzarella, grated parmesan, and fresh basil leaves, repeating for 3 layers.
Bake at 375°F for 25 to 30 minutes until bubbling and golden on top; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Tuscan White Bean & Kale Soup (Ribollita)
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat and sauté 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots, and 2 diced celery stalks for 6 minutes until softened.
Add 4 cloves minced garlic, 1 teaspoon chopped rosemary, and 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in 2 cans (15 oz each) drained cannellini beans, 1 can (14.5 oz) crushed tomatoes, and 4 cups vegetable broth; mash 1/2 cup of the beans against the pot wall to thicken the broth.
Simmer 15 minutes, fold in 4 cups chopped lacinato kale, and cook 5 minutes more until tender; season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Veal Osso Buco with Gremolata
instructions: Tie kitchen twine around 4 cross-cut veal shanks, season generously with salt and pepper, and dredge lightly in flour.
Sear the shanks in 2 tablespoons hot olive oil in a Dutch oven for 4 minutes per side until deeply browned, then transfer to a plate.
Sauté diced onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in the drippings for 6 minutes, deglaze with 1 cup dry white wine, and stir in 1 cup crushed tomatoes, 1.5 cups beef broth, and 1 bay leaf.
Return the shanks to the pot, cover tightly, and braise in a 325°F oven for 2 hours until fork-tender; finish with gremolata made of chopped parsley, lemon zest, and minced garlic.

name: Chana Masala
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet over medium heat and sizzle 1 teaspoon cumin seeds for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add 1 finely diced onion and sauté 6 minutes until golden, then stir in 3 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon grated ginger, 1 teaspoon coriander, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, and 1/2 teaspoon chili powder.
Add 2 diced ripe tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until broken down into a thick paste.
Stir in 2 cans (15 oz each) drained chickpeas and 1/2 cup water, simmer 10 minutes, and finish with 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1/2 teaspoon amchur (dried mango powder), and fresh cilantro.

name: Red Lentil Dal Tadka
instructions: Rinse 1.5 cups split red lentils until clear, then simmer in 4 cups water with 1/2 teaspoon turmeric and 1 teaspoon salt for 18 minutes until creamy and tender.
In a small skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat and sizzle 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, 1/2 teaspoon brown mustard seeds, and 2 dried red chilies for 20 seconds.
Add 1/2 diced onion, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tablespoon julienned ginger, and 1 diced tomato; sauté 4 minutes until softened.
Pour the sizzling spice tempering (tadka) directly over the cooked lentils, stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice and chopped cilantro, and serve.

name: Lamb Rogan Josh
instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons ghee in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, add 4 green cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick, and 4 cloves, and brown 2 lbs cubed lamb shoulder in batches.
Add 2 thinly sliced onions and cook 10 minutes until deeply caramelized, then stir in 1 tablespoon garlic-ginger paste.
Lower heat, stir in 2 tablespoons Kashmiri chili powder, 1 tablespoon fennel powder, 1 teaspoon ground ginger, and 1/2 cup whisked yogurt a few spoonfuls at a time so it doesn't curdle.
Pour in 1.5 cups warm water, season with salt, cover, and simmer gently for 55 minutes until the lamb is melt-in-your-mouth tender.

name: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Cut 1 small head cauliflower into florets and dice 2 medium potatoes into 3/4-inch cubes.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wide skillet, sizzle 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, and sauté 1 diced onion, 1 tablespoon minced ginger, and 2 cloves minced garlic for 4 minutes.
Add 1 diced tomato, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, and 1 teaspoon salt; cook 3 minutes until saucy.
Toss in the potatoes and cauliflower, cover tightly, and cook over medium-low heat for 18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender; sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon garam masala and cilantro.

name: Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi Stew)
instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon sesame oil in a pot over medium-high heat and sear 6 oz bite-sized pork belly slices for 3 minutes until browned.
Add 2 cups chopped aged sour kimchi, 1 tablespoon gochugaru, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon sugar; stir-fry together for 4 minutes.
Pour in 2.5 cups water and 1/4 cup kimchi brine, bring to a boil, and simmer 15 minutes to deepen the broth.
Slide 1 block (14 oz) sliced soft tofu on top, simmer 4 minutes more, and finish with sliced green onions.

name: Sundubu Jjigae (Vegan Soft Tofu Stew)
instructions: Whisk 1.5 tablespoons gochugaru, 1 tablespoon minced garlic, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon sesame oil into a chili paste.
Sauté 1/2 sliced onion, 4 sliced shiitake mushrooms, and 1/2 diced zucchini with the chili paste in a pot for 3 minutes.
Pour in 2 cups kombu vegetable broth, bring to a boil, and spoon large chunks of 1 tube (12 oz) extra-soft sundubu tofu into the bubbling broth.
Simmer gently for 5 minutes and garnish with sliced green onions.

name: Korean Fried Chicken (Yangnyeom)
instructions: Toss 2 lbs chicken wings with 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 3/4 cup potato starch, and 1 teaspoon baking powder until evenly coated.
Fry wings in 350°F oil for 8 minutes, drain on a rack for 5 minutes, then double-fry at 375°F for 3 minutes until shattering crisp.
Simmer 3 tablespoons gochujang, 3 tablespoons honey, 2 tablespoons ketchup, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, and 3 cloves minced garlic for 2 minutes until sticky.
Toss the hot crispy wings in the sweet-spicy glaze and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

name: Beef Bulgogi Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Slice 1.5 lbs ribeye steak paper-thin against the grain and toss with 1/2 grated Asian pear, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 4 cloves minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon grated ginger; marinate 20 minutes.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking and sear the beef in a single layer for 2 to 3 minutes until caramelized at the edges.
Garnish with sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds, and serve inside crisp butter lettuce cups.

name: Classic Smash Burger
instructions: Toast 2 buttered brioche buns cut-side down in a skillet until golden, and whisk 2 tablespoons mayo, 1 tablespoon ketchup, and 1 teaspoon mustard for burger sauce.
Divide 12 oz 80/20 ground chuck into four loose 3-oz balls without overworking the meat.
Place balls onto a smoking-hot cast-iron griddle, smash completely flat with a heavy spatula, and season with salt and pepper.
Sear 2 minutes until deeply crusted, flip, top each patty with a slice of American cheese for 45 seconds, and stack doubles onto the sauced buns with pickles and thinly sliced onion.

name: Loaded BBQ Pulled Jackfruit Nachos
instructions: Drain 1 can (20 oz) young green jackfruit, shred with a fork, and simmer in a skillet with 1/2 cup smoky BBQ sauce for 8 minutes until tender and caramelized.
Spread a layer of gluten-free tortilla chips on a parchment-lined sheet pan and top with the BBQ jackfruit, 1 cup drained black beans, and 1.5 cups vegan cheddar shreds.
Bake at 400°F for 8 to 10 minutes until melted, then top with sliced jalapeño, diced red onion, diced avocado, and fresh cilantro.

name: Herb-Crusted Rack of Lamb with Roasted Asparagus
instructions: Season 1 frenched rack of lamb with salt and pepper and sear fat-side down in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat for 4 minutes until browned.
Brush the meaty side with 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard and press on a mixture of 1/2 cup panko, 1 tablespoon chopped rosemary, 1 teaspoon thyme, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Toss 1 bunch trimmed asparagus with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan alongside the lamb and roast at 425°F for 18 to 20 minutes until internal temp reaches 130°F for medium-rare.
Rest the lamb 10 minutes before slicing between the ribs.

name: Sheet-Pan Honey Mustard Salmon & Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Toss 1 lb halved Brussels sprouts with 1.5 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan and roast at 425°F for 12 minutes.
Whisk 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard, 1.5 tablespoons honey, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder.
Push Brussels sprouts to the edges, place 4 salmon fillets in the center, brush generously with the honey-mustard glaze, and roast 10 to 12 minutes more until flaky.

name: Mapo Tofu (Vegan Mushroom Style)
instructions: Cube 14 oz medium-firm tofu and simmer gently in salted water for 3 minutes to firm up, then drain.
Toast 1 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorns in a dry wok for 1 minute, grind coarsely, then heat 2 tablespoons oil and sauté 1 cup finely minced shiitake mushrooms until browned.
Stir in 2 tablespoons doubanjiang (spicy fermented bean paste), 3 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon minced ginger for 1 minute until the oil turns red.

Add 1 cup vegetable broth, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and the tofu; simmer 5 minutes, thicken with a slurry of 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 2 tablespoons water, and top with scallions and ground Sichuan pepper.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions: Toss 1 lb diced chicken breast with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 teaspoon cornstarch; whisk 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons Chinese black vinegar, 1 tablespoon sugar, and 1 teaspoon cornstarch in a separate bowl for the sauce.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wok over high heat, sizzle 6 dried red chilies and 1 teaspoon Sichuan peppercorns for 15 seconds, then stir-fry the chicken for 3 minutes until seared.
Add 1 diced red bell pepper, 1 diced zucchini, 3 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon minced ginger; stir-fry 2 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour in the sauce, toss 1 minute until glossy, and fold in 1/2 cup roasted peanuts and sliced green onions.

name: Smashed Cucumber & Garlic Salad
instructions: Lay the flat side of a chef's knife over 2 English cucumbers and smack firmly to crack them open, then chop into bite-sized chunks.
Toss the cucumbers with 1/2 teaspoon salt in a colander for 10 minutes to draw out excess water, then pat dry.
Whisk 2 tablespoons Chinese black vinegar, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon chili oil, 1 teaspoon sugar, and 3 cloves grated garlic.
Toss the drained cucumbers in the dressing and top with toasted sesame seeds.

name: Scallion Pancakes (Cong You Bing)
instructions: Stir 3/4 cup boiling water into 2 cups all-purpose flour with chopsticks, then knead in 1/4 cup cold water until smooth; cover and rest 20 minutes.

Divide dough into 4 balls, roll each very thin into a rectangle, brush with sesame oil, sprinkle with salt and 1/3 cup finely sliced green onions, roll tightly into a log, coil into a snail shell, and flatten into a 6-inch disc.
Pan-fry each pancake in 1 tablespoon vegetable oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until flaky, golden, and crisp; cut into wedges.

name: Chicken Adobo
instructions: Combine 2 lbs bone-in chicken thighs, 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/2 cup cane vinegar, 8 crushed garlic cloves, 3 bay leaves, 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorns, and 1 tablespoon brown sugar in a wide pot.
Bring to a boil uncovered without stirring for 3 minutes, then lower heat, cover, and simmer 25 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Remove the chicken pieces and sear skin-side down in 1 tablespoon oil in a hot skillet for 2 minutes until browned, while reducing the braising liquid by half.
Return the chicken to the glossy adobo glaze and serve over steamed jasmine rice.

name: Sinigang na Hipon (Tamarind Shrimp Soup)
instructions: Bring 6 cups water, 2 quartered tomatoes, 1 quartered onion, and 1 cup sliced daikon radish to a boil and simmer 10 minutes until radish softens.
Stir in 1 packet tamarind soup base (or 1/3 cup tamarind paste) and 1 tablespoon fish sauce to taste.
Add 1 cup trimmed green beans and 1 lb shell-on or peeled shrimp; simmer 3 to 4 minutes until shrimp turn bright pink.
Fold in 2 cups chopped bok choy for 1 minute until wilted and serve piping hot.

name: Ginataang Kalabasa at Sitaw (Squash & Green Beans in Coconut Milk)
instructions: Sauté 1 diced onion, 4 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon minced ginger in 1 tablespoon oil for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add 3 cups cubed kabocha squash and 1 can (13.5 oz) coconut milk; simmer uncovered over medium-low heat for 12 minutes until squash is fork-tender.
Stir in 2 cups cut long green beans, season with salt and black pepper, and simmer 4 minutes more until beans are bright green and crisp-tender.

name: Vegetable Lumpia (Lumpiang Gulay)
instructions: Sauté 1 diced onion, 3 cloves minced garlic, and 1 cup diced pan-fried tofu in 1 tablespoon oil for 3 minutes.
Add 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 cup julienned carrots, 1 cup bean sprouts, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper; stir-fry 3 minutes until wilted, then drain in a colander until cool.
Place 2 tablespoons filling near the bottom edge of a lumpia wrapper, fold in the sides, roll tightly into a cylinder, and seal the edge with water.
Deep-fry in 350°F oil for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp; serve with spiced vinegar dipping sauce.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Spanakopita Skillet
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and sauté 4 sliced green onions and 3 cloves minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Add 2 cans (15 oz each) drained chickpeas and 1/2 cup water; simmer 5 minutes, lightly mashing a few chickpeas.
Fold in 5 oz baby spinach in handfuls until wilted, then remove from heat and stir in 1/3 cup chopped fresh dill, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese.

name: Greek Lamb Gyros with Homemade Tzatziki
instructions: Mix 1 lb ground lamb with 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon cumin, 2 cloves grated garlic, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper; form into a flat loaf and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes, then slice thinly.
Combine 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup grated squeezed cucumber, 1 tablespoon chopped dill, 1 clove grated garlic, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and a pinch of salt for tzatziki.
Warm 4 pita breads and fill with the sliced lamb, tzatziki, sliced tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion.

name: Fasolada (Greek White Bean & Tomato Stew)
instructions: Sauté 1 diced onion, 2 sliced carrots, and 2 sliced celery stalks in 3 tablespoons olive oil for 7 minutes until tender.

Stir in 2 tablespoons tomato paste and 1 teaspoon dried oregano for 1 minute, then add 2 cans (15 oz each) drained Great Northern beans, 1 cup crushed tomatoes, 3 cups vegetable broth, and 1 bay leaf.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until thick and velvety; season with salt, pepper, and an extra swirl of olive oil.

name: Crispy Cauliflower Buffalo Wings
ingredients: melted coconut oil or vegan butter
instructions: Whisk 3/4 cup chickpea flour, 3/4 cup water, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon paprika, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a smooth batter.
Dip 1 head of cauliflower cut into bite-sized florets into the batter, letting excess drip off, and arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake at 450°F for 20 minutes until golden and crisp, then toss gently in 1/2 cup hot sauce whisked with 2 tablespoons melted vegan butter.
Return to the oven for 8 minutes until sticky and caramelized.

name: Truffle Parmesan Garlic Fries
instructions: Cut 2 large russet potatoes into 1/4-inch matchsticks, soak in cold water 15 minutes, and pat completely dry.
Toss the fries with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, salt, and pepper, spread in a single layer on a sheet pan, and bake at 450°F for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway.
Immediately toss the hot fries with 1 teaspoon white truffle oil, 1/3 cup grated parmesan, and 2 tablespoons chopped parsley.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa & Roasted Chickpea Bowl
instructions: Simmer 1 cup rinsed quinoa in 2 cups water for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Toss 1 can drained chickpeas with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, and salt; roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until crunchy.
Whisk 3 tablespoons tahini, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 grated garlic clove, and 2 tablespoons warm water into a creamy dressing.
Assemble bowls with quinoa, crispy chickpeas, diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, Kalamata olives, and tahini drizzle.

name: Seared Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl
instructions: Cube 12 oz sushi-grade ahi tuna and toss gently with 2 tablespoons gluten-free tamari, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, 1 teaspoon rice vinegar, and 2 sliced green onions.
Divide warm seasoned sushi rice into 2 bowls and arrange the marinated tuna, 1/2 sliced avocado, 1/2 cup shelled edamame, and sliced cucumber on top.
Sprinkle generously with toasted black and white sesame seeds and serve immediately.

name: Pork Tonkotsu-Style Miso Ramen
instructions: Sear 8 oz sliced pork belly in a pot over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until browned, then set aside.
Sauté 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 tablespoon grated ginger in 1 teaspoon sesame oil for 1 minute, then whisk in 3 tablespoons red miso paste and 1 tablespoon tahini.
Pour in 4 cups chicken broth and 1 tablespoon soy sauce; simmer 10 minutes until rich and creamy.
Boil 2 packs fresh ramen noodles according to package directions, divide into bowls with the hot broth, and top with seared pork belly, halved soft-boiled eggs, sweet corn, and sliced scallions.

name: Okonomiyaki (Savory Cabbage Pancake)
instructions: Whisk 1 cup all-purpose flour, 3/4 cup water, 3 eggs, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a smooth batter, then fold in 4 cups finely shredded cabbage, 3 sliced green onions, and 2 tablespoons chopped pickled ginger.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, mound half the batter into a thick 7-inch pancake, cover, and cook 5 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip carefully, cover, and cook 5 minutes more until cooked through.
Drizzle generously with okonomiyaki sauce and Kewpie mayo in a crosshatch pattern and sprinkle with nori flakes.

name: Matcha Soba Noodle Salad with Edamame
instructions: Boil 8 oz soba noodles and 1 cup frozen shelled edamame together for 4 minutes until tender, then rinse thoroughly under cold water and drain.
Whisk 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil, 1 teaspoon maple syrup, and 1 teaspoon grated ginger.
Toss the chilled noodles and edamame with the dressing, julienned cucumber, diced avocado, and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Yakitori Skewers
instructions: Simmer 1/3 cup soy sauce, 1/3 cup mirin, 2 tablespoons sake, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, and 2 smashed garlic cloves in a small saucepan for 8 minutes until syrupy (tare glaze).
Cut 1.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs into 1-inch cubes and thread onto soaked bamboo skewers alternating with 1.5-inch pieces of green onion.
Broil or grill over high heat for 4 minutes per side, brushing twice with the tare glaze during the final 3 minutes until caramelized and glossy.

name: Wagyu-Style Beef Hamburg Steak (Hambagu)
instructions: Sauté 1 finely minced onion in 1 tablespoon butter until translucent and cool; soak 1/2 cup panko in 3 tablespoons milk.
Knead 1.5 lbs ground beef with the cooled onions, soaked panko, 1 egg, 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, salt, and pepper until tacky, then shape into 4 oval patties with a thumb indentation in the center.
Sear patties in a skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side, add 1/4 cup water, cover, and steam 5 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer 3 tablespoons ketchup, 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce, 2 tablespoons red wine, and 1 tablespoon butter in the pan drippings for 2 minutes and spoon over the steaks.

name: Crispy Karaage Fried Chicken
instructions: Cut 1.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces and marinate 20 minutes in 2 tablespoons gluten-free tamari, 1 tablespoon sake, 1 tablespoon grated ginger, 2 cloves grated garlic, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.
Dredge each piece thoroughly in 3/4 cup potato starch, shaking off excess.
Deep-fry in 350°F oil for 3 minutes, rest 2 minutes on a wire rack, then fry 1 minute more until ultra-crispy; serve with fresh lemon wedges.

name: Penne alla Vodka
instructions: Boil 12 oz penne in salted water until al dente, reserving 3/4 cup pasta water.

Sauté 1 finely diced shallot and 3 cloves minced garlic in 2 tablespoons olive oil for 3 minutes, then stir in 1/2 cup tomato paste and 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes and cook 3 minutes until darkened.
Deglaze with 1/3 cup vodka for 1 minute, lower heat, and whisk in 1/2 cup heavy cream until smooth.
Toss the drained penne, 1/2 cup grated parmesan, and splashes of pasta water into the sauce until silky and glossy.

name: Tuscan Grilled Zucchini & White Bean Bruschetta
instructions: Mash 1 can (15 oz) drained cannellini beans with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1 grated garlic clove, salt, and pepper until creamy.
Brush sliced zucchini planks and thick slices of ciabatta with olive oil and grill or pan-sear 2 to 3 minutes per side until charred.
Spread the whipped white beans over the warm toasted bread and top with diced grilled zucchini and torn fresh basil.

name: Truffle Wild Mushroom Tagliatelle
instructions: Sear 12 oz sliced mixed wild mushrooms in a wide skillet over high heat for 6 minutes until deeply browned, then add 1 minced shallot, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon fresh thyme.
Deglaze with 1/3 cup dry white wine until evaporated, stir in 1/3 cup heavy cream, and simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in 12 oz freshly boiled tagliatelle, 2 tablespoons black truffle butter, 1/2 cup grated parmesan, and 1/3 cup pasta water until creamy.

name: Sicilian Caponata (Sweet & Sour Eggplant Stew)
instructions: Sauté 1 large eggplant cut into 3/4-inch cubes in 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until browned and tender, then transfer to a bowl.
In the same pan, sauté 1 diced onion and 2 sliced celery stalks for 5 minutes, then add 1 cup crushed tomatoes, 1/3 cup pitted green olives, and 2 tablespoons drained capers.
Return the eggplant to the pan with 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar and 1 tablespoon sugar; simmer 8 minutes until glossy and fold in toasted pine nuts and fresh basil.

name: Cioppino (San Francisco-Italian Seafood Stew)
instructions: Sauté 1 thinly sliced fennel bulb and 1 diced onion in 3 tablespoons olive oil in a Dutch oven for 7 minutes until softened, then add 4 cloves minced garlic and 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes.
Pour in 1 cup dry white wine, 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes, and 2 cups seafood broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Nestle 1 lb scrubbed littleneck clams into the broth, cover, and cook 5 minutes until they begin opening, then add 1 lb cubed cod and 3/4 lb peeled shrimp.
Cover and simmer 4 minutes more until the fish is opaque, shrimp are pink, and clams are wide open; garnish with chopped parsley.

name: Crispy Garlic Bread Pizza Sub
instructions: Split 1 French baguette lengthwise, spread cut sides with 3 tablespoons softened butter mixed with 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder and 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, and toast under the broiler for 2 minutes.
Spoon 1 cup warm marinara sauce over the toasted garlic bread and pile on 2 cups shredded mozzarella and 1/4 cup grated parmesan.
Broil 3 minutes more until the cheese is bubbly and spotted brown; finish with red pepper flakes and slice into wedges.

name: Palak Paneer (Creamed Spinach with Paneer)
instructions: Blanch 10 oz fresh spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, plunge into ice water, squeeze dry, and blend with 1/4 cup water into a bright green purée.
Pan-fry 12 oz cubed paneer in 1 tablespoon ghee until golden on the edges, then set aside.

In the same pan, sizzle 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, sauté 1 diced onion, 3 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon grated ginger for 5 minutes, then cook 1 diced tomato with 1/2 teaspoon turmeric until soft.
Stir in the spinach purée, 1 teaspoon garam masala, 2 tablespoons heavy cream, and the seared paneer; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Goan Shrimp Curry (Sungta Hooman)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté 1 finely diced onion for 5 minutes until translucent.
Stir in 3 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon grated ginger, 1 teaspoon coriander powder, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, and 1/2 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder for 1 minute.
Add 1 diced tomato and 1 can (13.5 oz) coconut milk with 1 teaspoon tamarind paste; simmer 8 minutes until fragrant.
Add 1 lb peeled shrimp and 1 teaspoon salt, simmer 3 to 4 minutes until pink and curled, and garnish with fresh cilantro.

name: Pav Bhaji (Spiced Mashed Vegetable Sliders)
instructions: Boil 2 diced potatoes, 1.5 cups cauliflower florets, and 1/2 cup green peas in salted water for 12 minutes until soft, then drain and mash coarse.
Sauté 1 diced onion, 1 diced bell pepper, and 1 tablespoon garlic-ginger paste in 2 tablespoons butter for 5 minutes, then add 2 diced tomatoes and 2 tablespoons pav bhaji masala.
Fold in the mashed vegetables and 1/2 cup water, simmering and mashing together for 8 minutes until thick and velvety.
Toast split soft dinner rolls in melted butter on a skillet and serve alongside the bhaji topped with extra butter, cilantro, and lemon.

name: Baingan Bharta (Smoky Roasted Eggplant Mash)
instructions: Prick 2 whole globe eggplants with a fork and roast directly over a gas flame or under a hot broiler for 15 to 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and collapsed; cool, peel off skin, and mash flesh.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a skillet, sizzle 1 teaspoon cumin seeds, and sauté 1 diced onion, 1 minced green chili, 3 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon grated ginger for 5 minutes.
Add 2 diced tomatoes, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, and 1 teaspoon salt; cook 5 minutes until jammy, then stir in the smoky eggplant and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala for 6 minutes.

name: Tandoori Salmon Skewers with Mint Chutney
instructions: Whisk 1/2 cup Greek yogurt with 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1 teaspoon garam masala, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, 1/2 teaspoon Kashmiri chili powder, 1 tablespoon garlic-ginger paste, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Toss 1.5 lbs cubed skinless salmon in the spiced yogurt, thread onto skewers, and broil on a foil-lined pan for 7 to 8 minutes until charred at the edges.
Blend 1 cup cilantro, 1/2 cup mint leaves, 1/4 cup Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and salt into a bright chutney for serving.

name: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate 1.5 lbs bone-in chicken thighs for 30 minutes in 1/2 cup yogurt, 1 tablespoon biryani masala, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric, 1 tablespoon garlic-ginger paste, and 1 teaspoon salt.
Parboil 2 cups rinsed basmati rice in salted water for 5 minutes until 70% cooked, then drain.
Fry 2 thinly sliced onions in 3 tablespoons ghee until golden brown; remove half for garnish, add the marinated chicken and 1 chopped tomato to the pot, and cook 12 minutes.
Layer the parboiled rice, fresh mint, cilantro, fried onions, and 2 tablespoons saffron-infused warm milk over the chicken, cover tightly, and steam on lowest heat for 20 minutes.

name: Japchae (Sweet Potato Glass Noodles with Vegetables)
instructions: Boil 8 oz Korean sweet potato starch noodles (dangmyeon) for 6 minutes until chewy-tender, drain, rinse in cold water, and toss with 1 tablespoon sesame oil.
Blanch 4 oz spinach for 30 seconds, squeeze dry, and season with a pinch of salt and sesame oil.
Stir-fry 1/2 sliced onion, 1 julienned carrot, 1 sliced bell pepper, and 6 sliced shiitake mushrooms in 1 tablespoon oil for 4 minutes.

Toss the noodles and vegetables together in the skillet over medium heat with 1/4 cup gluten-free tamari, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon sesame oil for 2 minutes; top with sesame seeds.

name: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
instructions: Soak 1 lb Korean cylindrical rice cakes (garaetteok) in warm water for 10 minutes to soften.
In a wide skillet, bring 2 cups water, 3 tablespoons gochujang, 1 tablespoon gochugaru, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1.5 tablespoons brown sugar, and 2 cloves minced garlic to a simmer.
Add the drained rice cakes and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until the sauce thickens into a glossy red glaze and the cakes are chewy.
Top with halved hard-boiled eggs, sliced green onions, and toasted sesame seeds.

name: Bibimbap (Mixed Rice & Vegetable Bowl)
instructions: Blanch 4 oz spinach and 1 cup soybean sprouts separately, squeeze dry, and season each with minced garlic, sesame oil, and salt.
Sauté julienned carrot, julienned zucchini, and sliced shiitake mushrooms separately in a lightly oiled skillet for 2 minutes each until tender-crisp.
Arrange the seasoned vegetables neatly over bowls of warm short-grain rice, top each bowl with a sunny-side-up fried egg, and serve with a spoonful of gochujang and sesame seeds.

name: Galbi (Grilled Soy-Marinated Beef Short Ribs)
instructions: Blend 1/2 peeled Asian pear, 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 4 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon ginger, 2 tablespoons sesame oil, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper into a smooth marinade.
Pour over 2.5 lbs flanken-cut beef short ribs and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Grill or broil over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until caramelized and lightly charred; garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Kimchi Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Sauté 1/2 cup chopped squeezed kimchi in 1 teaspoon butter for 3 minutes until caramelized and moisture evaporates.
Mix 1 tablespoon mayonnaise with 1 teaspoon gochujang and spread inside 2 slices of sourdough bread; butter the outsides.
Layer cheddar, mozzarella, and the warm kimchi between the bread and grill in a skillet over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and molten.

name: Doenjang Jjigae (Soybean Paste Stew)
instructions: Dissolve 2.5 tablespoons Korean doenjang paste and 1 teaspoon gochugaru into 2.5 cups simmering kombu vegetable broth.
Add 1 diced small potato, 1/2 diced onion, and 4 sliced shiitake mushrooms; simmer 10 minutes until potato is tender.
Add 1/2 diced zucchini, 8 oz cubed firm tofu, and 2 cloves minced garlic; simmer 5 minutes more and garnish with sliced green onions.

name: Cajun Blackened Catfish with Dirty Rice
instructions: Rub 4 catfish fillets with 1 tablespoon olive oil and a blend of 1 tablespoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon onion powder, 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme, 1/4 teaspoon cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Sear the fillets in a smoking-hot cast-iron skillet for 3 to 4 minutes per side until darkly crusted and flaky.
Serve alongside warm rice tossed with sautéed diced bell pepper, celery, green onions, and Cajun spices.

name: Crispy Chickpea & Avocado Ranch Wrap
instructions: Pan-roast 1 can drained chickpeas in 1 tablespoon olive oil with 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/2 teaspoon salt over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until crispy.
Mash 1 ripe avocado onto 2 large tortillas and drizzle with vegan ranch dressing.
Layer chopped romaine, halved cherry tomatoes, and the warm crispy chickpeas down the center, then roll tightly.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Skillet
instructions: Sauté 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced green bell pepper, and 6 oz sliced mushrooms in 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet for 6 minutes until caramelized, then push to the side.
Add 1 lb thinly shaved ribeye steak, season with salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce, and sear 3 minutes while chopping with a spatula.
Toss the meat and peppers together, drape 5 slices of provolone cheese over the top, cover for 1 minute until melted, and serve hot.

name: Southern Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chili
instructions: Sauté 1 diced onion, 1 diced red bell pepper, and 3 cloves minced garlic in 1 tablespoon olive oil in a Dutch oven for 5 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons chili powder, 2 teaspoons cumin, and 1 teaspoon smoked paprika for 1 minute.

Add 1 large peeled diced sweet potato, 2 cans (15 oz each) drained black beans, 1 can (14.5 oz) fire-roasted tomatoes, and 2 cups vegetable broth; simmer 25 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender and finish with lime juice.

name: Garlic Butter Prime Ribeye with Roasted Baby Potatoes
instructions: Toss 1.5 lbs halved baby gold potatoes with 1.5 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast at 425°F for 25 minutes until crisp.
Season a thick 1.5-inch ribeye steak generously with kosher salt and black pepper and sear in 1 tablespoon high-heat oil in a cast-iron skillet for 3 minutes per side.

Lower heat, add 3 tablespoons butter, 4 crushed garlic cloves, and 2 rosemary sprigs, and baste the steak with foaming butter for 2 minutes until internal temp hits 130°F; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Crispy Beer-Battered Fish & Chips
instructions: Cut 2 large russet potatoes into thick fries, par-fry in 325°F oil for 5 minutes, and drain on paper towels.
Whisk 1 cup flour, 1/4 cup cornstarch, 1 teaspoon baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1 cup ice-cold beer into a smooth batter.
Increase oil to 375°F, fry the par-cooked fries for 3 minutes until golden and crisp, then dip salted cod fillets into the batter and fry 4 to 5 minutes until puffed and deep golden.

name: Dan Dan Noodles (Sesame Chili Noodles)
instructions: Brown 8 oz ground pork in a skillet over medium-high heat with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 teaspoon grated ginger until crisp.
In each serving bowl, whisk 2 tablespoons Chinese sesame paste (or tahini), 2 tablespoons chili oil, 1.5 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon black vinegar, and 1/4 cup hot noodle cooking water.
Boil 8 oz wheat noodles and 2 cups baby bok choy for 4 minutes, drain, toss into the bowls of sauce, and top with the crispy pork, green onions, and crushed peanuts.

name: Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry (Fanqie Chao Dan)
instructions: Whisk 5 eggs with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil; scramble softly in 1 tablespoon hot oil in a wok until just set, then transfer to a bowl.
Sauté 3 large wedged tomatoes and white parts of 3 green onions in 1 tablespoon oil for 3 minutes until juicy.
Stir in 1 tablespoon ketchup, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1 teaspoon cornstarch dissolved in 2 tablespoons water; fold the soft eggs back in for 30 seconds and top with green onion tops.

name: Broccoli & Garlic Oyster-Style Mushroom Stir-Fry
instructions: Blanch 4 cups broccoli florets in boiling water for 90 seconds until bright green, then drain.
Sear 8 oz sliced king oyster mushrooms in 1 tablespoon oil over high heat for 4 minutes until golden, then add 4 cloves minced garlic and 1 teaspoon grated ginger.

Toss in the broccoli along with 2 tablespoons vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1/3 cup water, and 1 teaspoon cornstarch; stir-fry 1 minute until glossy and drizzle with sesame oil.

name: Char Siu (Cantonese BBQ Pork)
instructions: Cut 2 lbs pork shoulder into 2-inch thick strips and marinate at least 30 minutes in 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce, 3 tablespoons honey, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon Shaoxing wine, 1 teaspoon five-spice powder, and 3 cloves grated garlic.
Place pork on a wire rack set over a foil-lined sheet pan with 1/2 cup water in the bottom and roast at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Flip the pork, brush with remaining marinade mixed with 1 tablespoon honey, and roast 15 to 20 minutes more until sticky and charred at the edges; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Steamed Ginger Scallion Sea Bass
instructions: Place 2 sea bass fillets (1.25 lbs total) on a heatproof plate topped with julienned ginger and 1 tablespoon Shaoxing wine, and steam over boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes until opaque.
Discard excess steaming liquid, pile thinly sliced green onions and cilantro over the fish, and drizzle with 2 tablespoons soy sauce mixed with 1 teaspoon sugar.
Heat 2 tablespoons neutral oil and 1 teaspoon sesame oil until smoking and pour directly over the scallions to sizzle.

name: Sesame Tofu & Snow Pea Stir-Fry
instructions: Cube 14 oz pressed extra-firm tofu, toss with 2 tablespoons cornstarch, and pan-fry in 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until crisp on all sides.
Add 2 cups trimmed snow peas, 1 sliced red bell pepper, and 2 cloves minced garlic; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Pour in 3 tablespoons gluten-free tamari, 1.5 tablespoons maple syrup, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, and 1 teaspoon sesame oil; toss 1 minute until glazed and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Tinola (Ginger Papaya Chicken Soup)
instructions: Sauté 2 tablespoons julienned ginger, 4 cloves crushed garlic, and 1 sliced onion in 1 tablespoon oil in a pot for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add 1.5 lbs bone-in chicken pieces and 1 tablespoon fish sauce; sear 4 minutes, then pour in 6 cups water and simmer 15 minutes.
Add 2 cups peeled cubed chayote or green papaya and simmer 8 minutes until tender, then fold in 3 cups baby spinach for 1 minute.

name: Pancit Bihon (Filipino Rice Noodle Stir-Fry)
instructions: Soak 8 oz thin rice vermicelli in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Sauté 1 sliced onion, 4 cloves minced garlic, and 1 cup thinly sliced chicken breast in 2 tablespoons oil for 4 minutes.
Add 1 cup julienned carrots, 1 cup sliced green beans, and 2 cups shredded cabbage; stir-fry 2 minutes, then pour in 1.5 cups chicken broth and 3 tablespoons gluten-free tamari.
Toss in the softened rice noodles and cook 3 to 4 minutes until all liquid is absorbed; serve with lemon or calamansi wedges.

name: Bicol Express (Spicy Coconut Pork Stew)
instructions: Sear 1.5 lbs bite-sized pork belly in a wide skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until lightly browned and fat renders.
Add 1 diced onion, 5 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tablespoon minced ginger; sauté 3 minutes.
Stir in 1.5 tablespoons shrimp paste and 1 can (13.5 oz) coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes until pork is tender.
Add 1/2 cup thick coconut cream and sliced green and red chilies; simmer 5 minutes until rich and oily.

name: Vegan Mushroom Sisig
instructions: Finely chop 12 oz oyster mushrooms and 8 oz pressed firm tofu; pan-fry in 2 tablespoons oil over high heat for 8 minutes until browned and crispy at the edges.
Add 4 cloves minced garlic, 1 finely diced red onion, and 1 minced jalapeño; cook 2 minutes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 tablespoon vegan mayo, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper until sizzling and savory.

name: Tortang Talong (Filipino Charred Eggplant Omelet)
instructions: Roast 3 whole Japanese eggplants under a broiler or over a gas burner for 10 minutes until skin is charred and flesh is soft, then peel off the skin keeping the stem intact.
Flatten each peeled eggplant gently into a fan shape with a fork.
Whisk 4 eggs with 1 clove grated garlic, salt, and pepper, dip each eggplant into the beaten egg, and pan-fry in 1 tablespoon oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.

name: Beef Kare-Kare (Savory Peanut Oxtail or Chuck Stew)
instructions: Simmer 2 lbs cubed beef chuck with 1 quartered onion and 4 cloves garlic in 5 cups beef broth for 65 minutes until tender.
Whisk 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter, 3 tablespoons toasted rice flour, and 1 teaspoon annatto powder with 1 cup warm broth until smooth, then stir into the pot.
Add sliced eggplant and cut green beans, simmer 6 minutes until tender, and fold in baby bok choy for 2 minutes.

name: Lemon Orzo & Feta Chicken Skillet
instructions: Season 1 lb diced chicken breast with oregano, salt, and pepper; sear in 1 tablespoon olive oil in a deep skillet for 4 minutes until browned.
Add 1 cup dry orzo and 3 cloves minced garlic, toast 1 minute, then pour in 2.25 cups chicken broth and the juice of 1 lemon.
Simmer covered for 10 minutes until orzo is tender, then fold in 3 cups baby spinach and 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese.

name: Baked Briam (Greek Roasted Ratatouille)
instructions: Thinly slice 2 zucchini, 2 potatoes, 1 eggplant, and 1 red onion into 1/4-inch rounds and arrange overlapping in a baking dish.
Whisk 1 cup crushed tomatoes, 1/3 cup olive oil, 4 cloves minced garlic, 1 tablespoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper, and pour evenly over the vegetables.
Cover with foil and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake 20 minutes more until tender and caramelized; top with fresh parsley.

name: Greek Spanakorizo (Lemon Dill Spinach Rice)
instructions: Sauté 5 sliced green onions in 3 tablespoons olive oil for 3 minutes, then stir in 1 cup medium-grain rice for 1 minute.
Add 2.5 cups vegetable broth and simmer covered for 12 minutes until rice is nearly tender.
Fold in 8 oz chopped fresh spinach, 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, salt, and pepper; cook 3 minutes until creamy.

name: Grilled Halloumi & Watermelon Mint Salad
instructions: Slice 8 oz halloumi cheese into 1/3-inch slabs and sear in a dry nonstick skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Arrange 4 cups cubed chilled watermelon, 1 sliced cucumber, and 1/3 cup pitted Kalamata olives on a platter.
Top with the warm grilled halloumi, torn fresh mint leaves, a drizzle of olive oil, lemon juice, and cracked black pepper.

name: Pastitsio (Greek Baked Pasta with Cinnamon Meat Sauce & Béchamel)
instructions: Brown 1 lb ground beef and 1 diced onion in 1 tablespoon olive oil, then simmer 15 minutes with 1.5 cups crushed tomatoes, 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
Boil 12 oz pasta until al dente and layer in a greased 9x13 baking dish, topped with the spiced beef sauce.
Whisk 4 tablespoons butter and 1/3 cup flour over medium heat for 2 minutes, gradually whisk in 3 cups warm milk until thick, and stir in 1/2 cup parmesan and a pinch of nutmeg.
Pour the béchamel over the meat layer and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes until golden brown.

name: Chili Cheese Loaded Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Cut 2 large sweet potatoes into fries, toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic powder, and salt, and bake at 425°F for 25 minutes until crisp.
Spoon 1.5 cups warm vegetarian black bean chili and 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar over the hot fries and bake 5 minutes until melted.
Top with dollops of sour cream and sliced green onions.

name: Crispy Korean-Italian Gochujang Vodka Rigatoni
instructions: Boil 12 oz rigatoni in salted water until al dente, reserving 3/4 cup pasta water.
Sauté 1 minced shallot and 3 cloves minced garlic in 2 tablespoons olive oil for 2 minutes, then cook 2 tablespoons gochujang and 2 tablespoons tomato paste for 2 minutes until caramelized.
Stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, toss in the rigatoni, 1/2 cup grated parmesan, and splashes of pasta water until glossy, and garnish with sliced scallions.

name: Thai-Inspired Peanut Noodle & Crispy Tofu Bowl
instructions: Pan-sear 14 oz cubed extra-firm tofu in 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat for 7 minutes until golden brown.

Whisk 1/3 cup creamy peanut butter, 2 tablespoons gluten-free tamari, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 tablespoon maple syrup, 1 teaspoon sriracha, 1 grated garlic clove, and 3 tablespoons warm water until smooth.
Toss 8 oz cooked rice noodles with the peanut sauce, shredded purple cabbage, julienned carrots, crispy tofu, and fresh cilantro.
